purpose: Keep test-scenario mechanics out of the generated Ordo playbook.

rules.rule: When testing retry/backtrack behavior, do not feed the same invalid answer indefinitely. Exercise the invalid path, then vary the next answer or advance to a valid answer. Do not mutate playbook business state merely to satisfy the test harness.
When targeting Ordo Tree Editor replay, package Auto Answers in the adapter-supported replay ZIP shape. This is not Ordo language validity.
Auto Answers should intentionally cover required happy, retry, reject, and recovery paths without introducing semantic assumptions into the playbook.
A limitation of replay/UI/test sequencing must be fixed in Auto Answers or the adapter, not encoded as a business-state mutation in the playbook.
